versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0

- Initial release of masterplan-builder.
- Guides users through building a complete, production-ready masterplan for new projects or systems across multiple categories (web, mobile, backend, AI assistant, etc.).
- Conducts detailed, live-researched interviews covering all design and technical aspects, tailored to project type.
- Ensures every recommendation is up-to-date by verifying choices in real time via web search.
- Outputs implementation-ready markdown masterplans, leaving no gaps or prototype-level decisions.
- Emphasizes environmental adaptability and thoroughly validates each plan against modern production standards.
